title: Fill the cells

steps.title: Check the key first
steps.body: For numbered cells, match the printed number to the key on page 2. The operator must first assign and test the physical markers.

steps.title: Fill within each cell
steps.body: Fill the outlined cell with its assigned colour. In a single-ink design, use the selected ink for every cell.

steps.title: Keep the blank spaces
steps.body: Leave areas without cells unmarked. Blank paper is not an extra numbered marker colour.

steps.title: Compare and record
steps.body: Compare a small filled area with the digital reference. Record number readability, colour matching and coverage.
